headline: Phoenix Mills amends security subscription agreement with O2 Renewable Energy XXVIII
sum: Phoenix Mills has executed an amendment to its Security Subscription and Shareholders Agreement governing its subscription of securities in O2 Renewable Energy XXVIII Private Limited, a renewable energy portfolio company, signalling continued capital commitment to the renewables sector.
detail: Phoenix Mills Limited has notified the National Stock Exchange of an amendment to its existing Security Subscription and Shareholders Agreement relating to its subscription of securities in O2 Renewable Energy XXVIII Private Limited. O2 Renewable Energy XXVIII is a Special Purpose Vehicle within the O2 Power portfolio, typically used to hold renewable energy generation assets (solar or wind). The amendment suggests either a repricing of equity, a phased investment tranche adjustment, or a governance restructuring. No consideration amount or specific terms of the amendment were disclosed in the NSE intimation.
